title: Accessible row summaries and compact/expanded density toggle for virtualized tables
creator: Sophie Chen
description: Introduce a lightweight, screen-reader-friendly summary layer and a compact/expanded density toggle for virtualized tables. Goal is to improve discoverability and orientation for keyboard and screen reader users when rows are virtualized and when density modes change, without regressing render performance or developer ergonomics.
context: Virtualized tables in the component library currently render large numbers of rows lazily. Screen reader users report losing context when navigating via keyboard or focusing rows that are outside the current DOM window. Additionally, switching density modes (compact/comfortable) does not provide a clear announcement and sometimes reflows cause focus loss. This ticket defines a design pattern and microcopy for a summarized row preview (a concise single-line readout) and an accessible density toggle that announces changes via an ARIA-live pattern.
decisions: 1) Implement a succinct row summary line that is exposed as an aria-describedby target for focused rows; 2) Place a density toggle in the table header toolbar with an ARIA-pressed toggle state and an aria-live status region that announces the new density; 3) Summary content limited to 140 characters and prioritized fields (primary cell, secondary metadata); 4) Use CSS-only compact/comfortable visual adjustments where possible, but allow runtime flag for per-instance overrides.
design_notes:
- Visual: small summary gutter (left of row) appears when row gains focus or hover on desktop; on mobile/touch it uses an overlay toast.
- Microcopy: summary template: "{primary} — {secondary} — {muted metadata}".
- Density toggle label: "Density: Compact / Comfortable"; tooltip explains token spacing changes.
- Focus handling: focus ring remains on original cell; summary is only additional descriptive text (aria-describedby).
- Edge cases: pinned columns and frozen headers should reference the same summary anchor so SR output is consistent.
technical_considerations:
- Virtualization boundaries: summaries must not force full DOM hydration; summaries should be driven by the same row data source and rendered offscreen when the row is virtualized.
- Performance: avoid repeated reflows; debounce density changes and batch DOM updates.
- Implementation patterns: prefer an offscreen aria-live region + aria-describedby on focused row. Use IntersectionObserver for keyboard-initiated focus to prefetch summary data.
- QA: test with VoiceOver, NVDA, and JAWS across Chrome/Firefox/Safari; verify with keyboard-only navigation and screen reader users.
- Analytics: add telemetry for density toggle usage and focus-to-summary latency.
acceptance_criteria: Screen reader announces a concise summary when row receives keyboard focus (max ~140 chars)
Switching density announces the new mode via an aria-live region without stealing focus
Keyboard navigation (tab/arrow keys) keeps focus stable when virtualization moves DOM windows
Visual summary gutter appears on focus/hover for non-touch devices and does not degrade scroll performance
Unit and e2e tests cover summary text generation, density toggle state, and a11y announcements
Design sign-off and accessibility review completed and documented

Conduct 3 moderated sessions with screen reader users to validate verbosity and placement
Finalize tokens and microcopy and hand off spec to engineering with code examples
Ship initial implementation behind feature flag; collect usage and performance telemetry
Iterate on feedback and remove feature flag for general availability
updates: 2025-02-14: Kickoff meeting with Eng (Mateo Ruiz) and PM (Lina Ortega). Agreed on scope: summaries + density toggle only — defer in-row complex actions to follow-up.
2025-02-20: Prototype shared in Figma. Initial approach uses left gutter summary; PM asked for compact visual alternative for narrow breakpoints.

2025-02-25: Accessibility review with external consultant (report attached in links). Key finding: prefer aria-describedby over live-region for focused rows to avoid noisy announcements during rapid navigation.
2025-02-28: Engineering spike confirms feasible pattern using offscreen summary render without hydrating entire virtual window. Estimated eng work: 3 sprints to move to GA behind flag.
2025-03-03: Design iteration 02: reduced summary verbosity to prioritized fields; submitted for design lead approval (Asha).
